description: This cool contemporary chest of drawers will add a unique style and great storage to your master bedroom. The piece has a sleek shape, with clean lines. The top is wood veneer so you can decorate with accent pieces, while the case sides and front are covered in rich black faux leather. There are five spacious drawers to meet all of your storage needs, with plenty of room for clothing and other essentials. Shiny silver handles add a modern touch to this gorgeous chest. Add this piece to your bedroom for a calming space where you can truly relax.
